title: Oozy Jamaican Rice Stew
description: A buttery, springy stew that soothes hangovers with fragrant sage, coconut milk, and a splash of lime, cooked in a bamboo tray for a touch of island tradition.
instructions: Rinse the jasmine rice until water runs clear, then set aside.
In a bamboo tray, heat the butter and olive oil over medium heat until melted.
Add the diced onion and minced garlic to the tray and sauté until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Stir in the ground ginger and chopped fresh sage, cooking for an additional minute until fragrant.
Pour in the coconut milk and vegetable broth, bringing the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Add the rinsed rice, cooked kidney beans, and lime juice, stirring to combine.
Cover the bamboo tray with foil and let the stew simmer for 18 minutes, or until the rice absorbs the liquid.
Fold in the chopped spinach during the last 2 minutes of cooking, allowing it to wilt.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste, then remove from heat.
Serve the stew hot, optionally garnishing with sliced scallions if desired.
